description:
## Summary

Release Candidate 2 — Hardening, Admin UI Polish, Plugin Framework & Quality.

- Bump version to 1.0.0-RC-2 across all canonical files and 35+ docs/config references
- Update CHANGELOG with 148 closed issues (Added, Fixed, Hardening, Testing, Chores, Documentation, Removed)
- Update roadmap: add RC2 section (Closed), clean up GA milestone, update GA due date
- Update container base images (manylinux2014, UBI10, UBI10-minimal)
- Update Python dependencies (redis, opentelemetry, cookiecutter, fastmcp, black, ruff, uv)
- Update Rust dependencies (cargo update across 4 crates)
- Update JavaScript dependencies (minimatch ReDoS fix, 0 vulnerabilities)
- Update DOMPurify CDN 3.3.1 → 3.3.2 with regenerated SRI hashes
- Fix jsonlint Makefile target to exclude .venv/.git/.cache directories

## Validation completed

- [x] Version bump (bump2version + manual stale reference sweep)
- [x] CHANGELOG updated and verified against codebase
- [x] Roadmap updated (RC2 closed, GA cleaned)
- [x] Security advisories checked (1 Dependabot high — minimatch, fixed by npm update)
- [x] Container base images updated to latest
- [x] Python/Rust/JS/CDN dependencies updated
- [x] Code formatting and linting (autoflake, isort, black, pre-commit)
- [x] pip-audit clean
- [x] Rust checks passed (fmt, clippy, tests)
- [x] npm audit: 0 vulnerabilities
- [x] SRI hashes regenerated and verified (15/15)
- [x] Secrets scanning (dodgy, gitleaks) — clean
- [x] DevSkim — no critical/high blockers
- [x] Semgrep — no new critical findings
- [x] Container build, hadolint, dockle, trivy — no blockers
- [x] Helm lint passed, chart packaged
- [x] Embedded mode verified (Playwright)
- [x] SSO flow verified (Keycloak redirect + PKCE)
- [x] Monitoring stack verified (Prometheus, Grafana dashboards)
- [x] PII filter plugin verified end-to-end (SSN, credit card, email, AWS key masking via live RPC)
- [x] Upgrade validation passed (SQLite fresh/upgrade, PostgreSQL fresh/upgrade)
- [x] Python package build + verify (twine PASSED, pyroma 10/10)
